thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: GPU capacity exhaustion + autoscaling stalled. Affected: inference/gpu-workers queue growth, user requests seeing 5xx/latency. Paging oncall (eric_oncall).

pagerduty: PagerDuty alert - high queue size on gpu-worker service, HPA not reacting to custom metrics.

eric_oncall: on it. I'm pulling graphs now, please leave any immediate mitigation suggestions in-thread.

dan_support: multiple customers reporting 503s for /v1/generate and long tail latency. Example customer: "acme-inc" - requests timing out after 30s.

alice_sre: seeing GPU pod queue (pending requests) climb from ~200 -> 1200 over 10m. Replica count pinned at 8, HPA target is custom metric 'gpu_queue_length' but adapter returning 500s.

frank_metrics: prometheus-adapter is showing repeated timeouts and then OOM kills in logs. snippet:```
E0305 18:32:01.123 prom-adapter main.go: failed to serve metrics: context deadline exceeded
I0330 18:34:23.456 runtime: out of memory: killing process
```

alice_sre: so HPA can't get metrics -> no scale. autoscaler (cluster-autoscaler) isn't triggered because pods are not pending for CPU/Memory. Queue builds up on runtime.

bob_runtime: we can do two things now: 1) manual scale GPU workers up to relieve queue (if we have quota), 2) restart prometheus-adapter to clear stuck state. I'll try manual scale if platform OK.

gina_platform: cloud GPU quota check: current limit at 30 GPUs in prod project, usage at 28. If you scale to 20 replicas that's 40 GPUs -> will hit quota and fail. We can request quota increase but that will take time.

alice_sre: plan B: enable fallback routing to lower-cost model (smaller variant) for non-SLOn customers and drop concurrency per pod. Also throttle ingress for non-critical routes.

bob_runtime: executing manual scale to 12 replicas (to avoid quota).```
kubectl scale deployment/gpu-worker -n inference --replicas=12
```

infra-bot: Deployment gpu-worker scaled from 8 to 12 by bob_runtime.

frank_metrics: rolling restart prometheus-adapter now:```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/prometheus-adapter -n monitoring
```

incident-bot: Routing rule change: applied temporary rate-limit for api/v1/generate for free-tier customers (carla_prod & ops).

carla_prod: thanks. Notifying SRE page for affected customers. I'll send targeted messages to top-5 affected tenants.

dan_support: sent customer note to acme-inc and beta-co. offering incident updates and asked whether they want failover to smaller models.

alice_sre: after restart, adapter pods booting but still high scrape backlog. I'm watching HPA logs.

frank_metrics: found root cause candidate: a recent scrape config change increased label cardinality for model_exporter metrics (per-request tags). Adapter memory spiked and crashed. I'm rolling back that scrape stanza.

```
# removed problematic relabel_configs for model_exporter
kubectl apply -f monitoring/prometheus-scrape-rollback.yaml
```

frank_metrics: adapter memory usage dropping, no more OOMs in last 90s.

alice_sre: HPA made a new request, got metric values, triggered scale to 18 replicas. Queue is starting to drain (pending -> 600 -> 300 in 7m).

bob_runtime: also enabled temporary runtime-level concurrency cap to 1 per GPU pod to reduce head-of-line blocking. Commands:
```
kubectl patch deployment/gpu-worker -n inference --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/1/value","value":"1"}]'
```

gina_platform: cloud quota alert: we briefly hit the soft limit; requested emergency quota bump (approved) to avoid further manual failures.

dan_support: customer-impact summary so far: ~12 tenants experienced elevated errors/latency for 20-40 minutes; top customers received manual failover offer. No PII exposure.

eric_oncall: current status: degraded -> partial recovery. Autoscaling restored after adapter rollback + restart. Manual scale + rate-limiting bought time. Will hand off to night oncall in 1 hour.

harry_manager: I'll take the handoff at 02:00 UTC (harry_manager). frank_metrics, alice_sre, bob_runtime please prepare a short postmortem draft and list action items.

alice_sre: initial action items: 1) add resource limits and liveness probe to prometheus-adapter, 2) block high-cardinality label configs in scrape configs via CI lint, 3) add fallback HPA target (CPU-based) when custom metrics unavailable, 4) update runbook for manual scaling and throttle steps.

frank_metrics: agree. I'll add a memory limit bump for adapter and a CI check to detect high-cardinality relabels.

bob_runtime: I'll add a runtime metric that reports queue length to both custom metrics and a direct /health endpoint so we have redundancy. Also will add automated temporary fallback router to smaller model variants.

carla_prod: will prepare customer communication template and credit offers for impacted tenants.

eric_oncall: handing off. Summary for next oncall: prometheus-adapter experienced OOM after scrape config change increased cardinality, causing custom metrics to fail -> HPA didn't scale -> GPU queue growth -> client errors. Mitigations performed: manual scale, restart adapter, rollback scrape config, temporary rate-limits and fallback routing.

harry_manager: taking over. please assign postmortem owner in incident tracker and include SLAs/customers impacted list. I will schedule a 1-hour war room tomorrow to go over RCA.

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1768456789 by eric_oncall. Postmortem owner: frank_metrics (proposed).

alice_sre: evidence notes saved to the incident ticket: graphs, adapter logs, kube events, commands used.

dan_support: closing customer update loop for now; will reopen if they request more info.

eric_oncall: resolved to stable but monitoring closely for 2 hours. Good work everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: If this thread becomes quiet, on-call handoff will be considered complete at 1768460400.
